premises.text: Diabetes care tools fail because manual logging is tedious, digital hardware/software are incompatible, and no platform connects patients to their support network
premises.evidence_span: proper care for diabetes is inadequate and in many countries broken due to the following usability and technical problems

premises.text: A smart cable connects existing glucometers to smart devices via the audio jack, compatible with most meters including emerging markets
premises.evidence_span: this smart cable is compatible with majority of the glucometers in the market, even those in emerging markets

premises.text: App color-codes out-of-range readings and lets users tag meals, medication, moods, and foods, then share interpretable graphs with doctors
premises.evidence_span: the app color codes some of the readings purple or orange if certain numbers are out of range

premises.text: Secure cloud partner view lets family/care partners monitor stats, send encouragement, and preset alerts for missed syncs or out-of-range numbers
premises.evidence_span: I can pre-set notifications that would alert me should grandma forget to sync to test herself or if her numbers are out of whack

premises.text: Patient-centric platform enables third-party interactions (insurers, pharmacies) and future API/service partnerships
premises.evidence_span: HealthiSync also enables a patient-centric platform. enabling new forms of interaction with third parties to the patient

value.text: Aggregated glucose data that gives patients control over diabetes management
value.evidence_span: Health to Sync aggregates glucose data, ultimately giving control back to you

causal_links.evidence_span: basically solved three issues. One, data tedium. Two, data transferability integrity
And three, data availability to the support network
enabling new forms of interaction with third parties to the patient

notes: Three numbered pain points folded into one problem premise (v1.5.1 §4.1.6). App tagging/graphs treated as facets of the patient logging surface with the cable. Partner function kept separate as distinct support-network capability. Geographic launch plans treated as traction/GTM timing, not a separate premise.
